title: Deleting the last of two purchases (10 at 100 and 8 at 140, average 117.777778): the reference system recomputes the average from the movements left and goes back to 100, this application leaves the average the item carried

delete_and_restore.note: The second purchase deleted: it goes to the trash, its journal is erased, the stock goes back to 10 and the average goes back to 100.00; restored, it comes back with a new journal number and a new stock movement and the average is 117.777778 again

cases.reason: The reference system recomputes the average cost of the item from the movements that stay when a purchase is deleted. This application gives the stock back and reverses the journal but does not recompute the cost the item carries (G-43), so the next sale is costed at the old average; proposal E56 has WP17 reverse the valued movement so that the average follows.
